name: Veolia
description: Global water technology group whose Oil & Gas offering covers sulfate-removal nanofiltration packages (SRP) and produced-water treatment for injection and discharge. Its anaerobic digestion brands ADI Systems (AnMBR) and Biothane (Biobed EGSB) are cited by name on the WWT cards.
notes: Aliases added 2026-11-16 so the ADI Systems and Biothane supplier names on wwt-anmbr and wwt-uasb resolve to the parent rather than sitting in the coverage queue as missing vendors.
